source_files.name: Motor Vehicle Dealer-2026-May-27-05-30-02.xls
source_files.description: Independent (GDN) and Franchised Motor Vehicle Dealers

notes: Data sourced from TxDMV LACE (Licensing and Consumer Affairs) Salesforce portal.
TxDMV publishes downloadable XLS spreadsheets for each dealer category, updated daily.
Data is current as of 05/27/2026 per the portal timestamp.
GDN (General Distinguishing Number) file contains both Franchised and Independent dealers, distinguished by DealerType column.
RV Manufacturers file is product-level (1,044 rows for product lines); deduplicated to 79 unique entities by license number.
4 empty/header rows were removed during cleaning.
Manufacturers and Distributors may be located out-of-state (e.g., Indiana, Michigan, California) since they register to sell into Texas.
owner_principal field is only populated for Manufacturers & Distributors (from FirstName/LastName columns); not available for GDN or Salvage dealers.
No bulk API endpoint exists; data obtained via direct file download links from the Salesforce portal.
Bond company data is available only for GDN dealers (independent dealers require surety bonds).

completeness.email: ~95% populated for GDN dealers, sparse for others
completeness.owner_principal: Only populated for Manufacturers & Distributors (~14% of total)

known_limitations: RV Manufacturer records lack physical address, phone, email, and county data
Issue date not available for Salvage Dealers or RV Manufacturers
owner_principal not available for GDN or Salvage dealers (would require individual license lookups)
